summary: Comprehensive backend (29 pytest tests) + frontend e2e testing of Meme Coin Auto Trading App. Backend 100% pass: auth (register/login/me/logout), all coin endpoints (trending/detail/chart/dex), trades (buy/sell/insufficient errors), portfolio, all 4 bot strategies create+toggle+delete, AI signals (real Claude Sonnet 4.5 via Emergent LLM key returning structured BUY/SELL/HOLD), wallets CRUD. Frontend: Landing, Register, Login, Dashboard (KPIs + trending + chart + positions), Bots, Trades, Signals, Wallet pages all render & auth-gate correctly. ProtectedRoute redirect works. JWT persisted in localStorage and used in Authorization header. ONE critical UI issue: Coin Detail route /coins/{id} renders an empty/black page with 0 testids, blocking BUY-trade and AI-signal flows from the UI.

ui_bugs.issue: Navigating to /coins/dogecoin renders a blank black page with no testids and no content. Route may be mismatched (e.g., App.js uses /coin/:id vs Dashboard linking to /coins/:id), or component throws silently. Blocks UI BUY trade + AI signal generation flow from CoinDetail page (backend endpoints themselves work).

issues: Hydration warning: <span> cannot be child of <option> (caused by visual-editor instrumentation wrapping option text). Non-blocking but pollutes console.

action_items: Fix CoinDetail route/component: verify /coins/:coin_id path in App.js matches the link generated by Dashboard trending list and that CoinDetail.jsx renders without errors. Check for runtime exception swallowed in component.
(Optional) Suppress or work around the <option><span> hydration warning on Signals page.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 706 lines; consider splitting into routers (auth, coins, trades, bots, ai, wallets) and a separate bot_engine.py module for maintainability.
JWT_SECRET in backend/.env is a static literal labeled 'change-in-production' — fine for paper-trading sandbox, but flag for prod.
fetch_prices uses module-level _price_cache dict — works for single-process uvicorn but will desync across workers if scaled.

Bot engine evaluate_bot for DCA: when last_run is None, it executes immediately and updates last_run only via outer loop's set; logic is correct but edge-case for bots created mid-loop should be reviewed.
_execute_trade rounds via float division; for very low-priced meme coins (e.g. MOG ~ $0.00000015) precision could be an issue — consider Decimal for amount_coin.
AI signal endpoint always inserts to db.ai_signals even on error/HOLD fallback; acceptable but worth noting.
CoinDetail route mismatch is the main user-facing defect.
test_credentials: Tests register fresh users dynamically (email TEST_<uuid>@memetrade.io / TestPass2026!). Pre-seed user degen@memetrade.io / MemeMoon2026! was not pre-created in DB but JWT email/password registration works fine for any new email.
seed_data_creation: Each backend test class creates its own ephemeral user; tests use TEST_ prefix for cleanup identification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully solid — re-running pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py should yield 29/29 again. Focus next iteration on: (1) verifying CoinDetail page renders after main agent fix, (2) executing UI BUY flow from CoinDetail, (3) UI AI signal generation, (4) UI bot creation via new-bot-btn modal. Frontend testid map: register-{name|email|password}-input, register-submit-btn; login-{email|password}-input, login-submit-btn; nav-{dashboard|bots|signals|trades|wallet}; new-bot-btn; signal-coin-select; connect-phantom-btn, connect-metamask-btn, manual-add-btn.
rca_of_the_issue: CoinDetail blank page: navigating to /coins/dogecoin produced an empty document.body with 0 elements carrying data-testid. ProtectedRoute did not redirect (URL stayed at /coins/dogecoin), so auth is fine. Most likely cause: route path mismatch in App.js (e.g., declared as /coin/:id while Dashboard links to /coins/:id) leading to a no-match render, OR CoinDetail.jsx throwing during render (e.g., destructuring an undefined response). Reproduction: register/login -> click any trending coin row OR navigate directly to /coins/dogecoin -> blank screen. Mitigation: open /app/frontend/src/App.js and confirm Route path matches the /coins/:coin_id pattern used by Dashboard/Landing trending list, then verify CoinDetail.jsx handles loading state without crashing.
